title: Horrible Bosses
tagline: Three bad bosses. One good dinner.
about: Three friends with unbearable bosses come up with a very bad plan to get rid of them.
cue: Serve the snacks when the three friends start plotting at the bar.

    StartersMurder consultant loaded beef nachosCorn chips with spiced beef, black beans, cheddar, guacamole and salsaHow to make it400g beef mince1 onion, diced2 tsp ground cumin1 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp chilli powder3 tbsp tomato paste400g tin black beans, drained300g corn chips200g cheddar, grated2 avocados1 lime150g sour cream200g tomato salsa1 jar pickled jalapenosBrown the mince with the onion. Add the ground cumin, smoked paprika, chilli powder, tomato paste and a splash of water and simmer. Stir in the black beans.Layer the corn chips in a baking dish with the beef and cheddar.Bake at 200°C until the cheese melts.Mash the avocados with lime and salt.Top with guacamole, sour cream, salsa and jalapenos.Dive bar buffalo chicken wingsBaked chicken wings tossed in hot sauce butter, with blue cheese dip and celeryHow to make it1.2kg chicken wings, jointed1 tbsp baking powder80ml hot sauce50g butter150g sour cream80g blue cheese1 lemon4 celery sticksHeat the oven to 230°C. Pat the wings dry and toss with the baking powder and salt.Bake on a rack over a tray for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp.Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss the wings through.Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream with a squeeze of lemon.Serve with the dip and celery sticks.MainsSwap your boss double bacon cheeseburgersDouble beef patties, bacon and special sauce, with oven friesHow to make it1kg frozen fries8 rashers of bacon4 tbsp mayonnaise2 tbsp tomato sauce1 tbsp American mustard1 tbsp chopped dill pickles, plus slices to serve800g beef mince8 slices of cheddar4 milk buns1 onion, slicedBake the fries at 220°C until crisp.Grill the bacon until crisp.Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, mustard and chopped pickles into a sauce.Roll the mince into balls and smash each flat onto a very hot greased pan. Season and cook, flip, top with the sliced cheddar and cook briefly.Stack two patties in each toasted bun with bacon, pickles, onion and sauce.SweetsBad plan salted caramel browniesDark chocolate salted caramel brownies. Whisk in the sugar, then the eggs one at a time. Fold in the flour, cocoa and a pinch of salt.Spread into a lined 20cm square tin. Drop the caramel over the top and swirl with a knife. Sprinkle with sea salt.Bake at 170°C until just set.Cool, then serve warm with ice cream.Break room cinnamon jam doughnutsYeast doughnuts in cinnamon sugar, filled with raspberry jamHow to make it300g plain flour7g dried yeast140g caster sugar150ml warm milk1 egg40g butter, melted2 tsp ground cinnamon250g raspberry jam, warmed1 L vegetable oil, for fryingMix the flour, yeast, some of the sugar and a pinch of salt. Add the milk, egg and butter and knead.Prove until doubled.Roll into balls and prove again.Fry in the vegetable oil at 170°C, turning once, then drain.Toss in the remaining sugar mixed with cinnamon.Poke a hole in each and pipe in the jam.DrinksGlengoolie Blue whisky sourScotch, lemon, honey syrup and egg white shaken foamyHow to make it3 tbsp honey240ml scotch whisky4 lemons, juiced4 egg whites (from 4 eggs)1 orange1 bag iceStir the honey into hot water and cool to make a syrup.Shake the whisky, lemon juice, honey syrup and egg white in a jar without ice.
